description: Text content blocks - all text must be wrapped in Text component
reason: React Native requires all text to be wrapped in Text component - block elements not supported

alternatives.p: BodyText component or Text with paragraph styling
alternatives.hr: View with border styling for horizontal rule
alternatives.ul: FlatList or ScrollView with bullet styling
alternatives.ol: FlatList or ScrollView with numbered items
alternatives.li: View with list item styling and Text content
alternatives.pre: Text with monospace font and preserved whitespace
alternatives.blockquote: View with quote styling containing Text
